blocks.title: Tuần 1 · Mở khóa, làm quen cô và bạn

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 1. Tuần 1 · Mở khóa – Làm quen cô và bạn

web.label: Ngày 1. Mở khóa · Chào cô, chào bạn

en.tu: Mới: hi, bye-bye
en.cum: hi, Bông / hi, Leo / bye-bye, Anna
en.cau: Hi! I'm Bông. / Hi! I'm Leo. / Bye-bye!
en.truyen: Hi, I'm Bông — Bông waves: “Hi! I'm Bông.” Leo waves: “Hi! I'm Leo.” Ding, dong! Bông and Leo wave: “Bye-bye! Bye-bye!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "say hi song for preschool wave hello"

web.label: Ngày 2. Mở khóa · Nhìn, nghe, vỗ tay

en.tu: Mới: look, listen, clap | Ôn: hi, bye-bye
en.cum: look at me / listen, please / clap, clap, clap
en.cau: Look! / Listen! / Clap, clap, clap! / Hi! Look at me!
en.truyen: Look and listen — Leo: “Hi, Bông! Look!” Bông looks. Leo: “Listen!” Clap, clap, clap! Bông: “Clap, clap, clap!” Leo and Bông: “Bye-bye!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "look listen clap song for kids classroom"

en.flash: Mới: hi, bye-bye, look, listen, clap (tranh: bạn vẫy tay chào, bạn vẫy tay tạm biệt, đôi mắt nhìn, đôi tai nghe, hai tay vỗ)
en.slide: 1) Nghe và làm theo (5 lệnh): Look! / Listen! / Clap, clap, clap! / Hi! / Bye-bye! 2) Nghe tên và chạm đúng bạn trên slide (3 câu): Hi, Bông! / Hi, Leo! / Hi, Anna! 3) Trò chơi Chiếc hộp bí mật: cô mở hộp và nói Look!, con nhìn tranh bạn mới hiện ra rồi vẫy tay nói Hi!
en.truyen: Hi, I'm Bông — Bông comes to class. She looks: Leo! “Hi! I'm Bông.” “Hi! I'm Leo.” Leo claps: clap, clap, clap. Bông claps: clap, clap, clap. Listen! Ding, dong! “Bye-bye, Leo!” “Bye-bye, Bông!”
en.baihat: Hi Song — giai điệu Frère Jacques: Hi, hi, Bông! Hi, hi, Leo! / Look, look, look! Look, look, look! / Listen, listen, listen! Listen, listen, listen! / Clap, clap, clap! Clap, clap, clap!

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 2. Tuần 1 · Mở khóa – Hát, nhảy và bài đầu vào

web.label: Ngày 3. Mở khóa · Hát và nhảy (kèm bài đầu vào nghe – chạm tranh)

en.tu: Mới: sing, dance | Ôn: look, listen, clap
en.cum: let's sing / let's dance / good job
en.cau: Let's sing! / Let's dance! / Good job! / Look and listen.
en.truyen: Let's sing! — Anna: “Hi! I'm Anna. Let's sing!” Leo: “La, la, la!” Bông: “Let's dance!” Anna, Leo and Bông dance and clap. “Good job!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "let's sing and dance action song preschool"

web.label: Ngày 4. Mở khóa · Ôn tuần + truyện Buổi học đầu tiên

en.tu: Ôn: hi, bye-bye, look, listen, clap, sing, dance
en.cum: hi, Anna / look at me / let's sing / let's dance / good job
en.cau: Hi! I'm Leo. / Look! Listen! / Let's sing and dance! / Good job! Bye-bye!
en.truyen: Our first class — Bông, Leo and Anna come to class. “Hi! Hi! Hi!” Look! Listen! La, la, la. “Let's sing!” “Let's dance!” Clap, clap, clap. “Good job!” “Bye-bye, Anna! Bye-bye, Leo! Bye-bye, Bông!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "bye bye song for kids preschool"

en.flash: Mới: sing, dance | Ôn: hi, bye-bye, look, listen, clap
en.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – nghe và chạm tranh (8 tranh, cô ghi lại con đã nhận ra từ nào): hello / cat / dog / apple / red / one / mommy / ball. 2) Nghe lệnh và làm theo (4 lệnh): Let's sing! / Let's dance! / Clap, clap, clap! / Look! 3) Nghe và chạm bạn được khen (3 câu): Good job, Anna! / Good job, Leo! / Good job, Bông!
en.truyen: Let's sing and dance — Anna comes to class. “Hi! I'm Anna.” Bông and Leo: “Hi, Anna!” Listen! La, la, la. “Let's sing!” Bông, Leo and Anna sing. “Let's dance!” They dance and clap. “Good job!” Ding, dong! “Bye-bye, Anna! Bye-bye, Leo! Bye-bye, Bông!”
en.baihat: Let's Sing — giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat: Sing, sing, sing with me, / La, la, la, la, la! / Dance, dance, dance with me, / Clap, clap, clap, clap, clap! (Đoạn kết: Bye-bye, bye-bye, bye-bye, bye-bye, / Good job, bye-bye!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 3. Unit 1 · Greeting – Chào cô, chào bạn

web.label: Ngày 5. Unit 1 · Chào cô giáo

en.tu: Mới: hello, goodbye, teacher | Ôn: hi, bye-bye
en.cum: hello, teacher / goodbye, teacher / hello, Bông / goodbye, Leo
en.cau: Hello, teacher! / Goodbye, teacher! / Hello, Bông! / Goodbye, Leo!
en.truyen: Hello, teacher! — Bông comes to class: “Hello, teacher!” The teacher waves: “Hello, Bông!” Listen! Ding, dong! “Goodbye, teacher!” “Goodbye, Bông!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "hello goodbye song for preschool"

web.label: Ngày 6. Unit 1 · Chào bạn mới: boy, girl

en.tu: Mới: friend, boy, girl | Ôn: hello, goodbye, teacher
en.cum: hello, friend / my friend / a boy / a girl
en.cau: Hello, friend! / I'm a boy. / I'm a girl. / Leo is my friend.
en.truyen: My friend Leo — Bông: “Hello, Leo!” Leo: “Hello, Bông! I'm a boy.” Bông: “I'm a girl.” Bông and Leo clap: “Leo is my friend! Bông is my friend!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "boy and girl song for toddlers hello friend"

en.flash: Mới: hello, goodbye, teacher, friend, boy, girl | Ôn: hi, bye-bye, look, listen, clap
en.slide: 1) Nghe và chạm tranh (4 câu): hello / goodbye / teacher / friend. 2) Nghe và chọn bạn trai hay bạn gái (4 câu): I'm a boy. (Leo) / I'm a girl. (Bông) / I'm a girl. (Anna) / I'm a boy. (Nhan) 3) Trò chơi Vẫy tay: cô nói Hello, teacher! thì con vẫy tay chào, cô nói Goodbye, friend! thì con vẫy tay tạm biệt (6 lượt).
en.truyen: Hello, friend! — Bông comes to class: “Hello, teacher!” Teacher: “Hello, Bông!” Leo comes: “Hello, teacher! Hello, Bông!” Bông: “Hello, Leo! I'm a girl.” Leo: “I'm a boy. Bông is my friend.” Ding, dong! “Goodbye, teacher! Goodbye, friend!”
en.baihat: Hello, Teacher — giai điệu Frère Jacques: Hello, teacher! Hello, teacher! / Hello, friend! Hello, friend! / I'm a boy, I'm a girl; I'm a boy, I'm a girl. / Hello, hello! Hello, hello!

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 4. Unit 1 · Greeting – Yes hay no? Bạn mới Anna

web.label: Ngày 7. Unit 1 · Yes hay no?

en.tu: Mới: yes, no | Ôn: boy, girl, friend, teacher
en.cum: yes, teacher / no, no / a boy or a girl
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi Yes/No với Are you…? / Is it…?] Are you a boy? – Yes! / Are you a girl? – No! / Is it Leo? – Yes!
en.truyen: Yes or no? — Teacher: “Leo, are you a girl?” Leo: “No, no! I'm a boy.” Teacher: “Bông, are you a girl?” Bông: “Yes! I'm a girl.” Leo and Bông clap: “Good job!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "yes no song for kids preschool"

web.label: Ngày 8. Unit 1 · Ôn unit + truyện Bạn mới Anna

en.tu: Ôn: hello, goodbye, teacher, friend, boy, girl, yes, no, look, listen, clap
en.cum: hello, teacher / goodbye, friend / my friend / a boy / a girl
en.cau: Hello! I'm Anna. I'm a girl. / Are you a boy? – No! / Are you my friend? – Yes! / Goodbye, teacher!
en.truyen: A new friend — Anna comes to class: “Hello, teacher! Hello!” Leo: “Hello! Are you a boy?” Anna: “No! I'm a girl. I'm Anna.” Leo: “I'm Leo. I'm a boy.” Bông: “Anna, are you my friend?” Anna: “Yes!” Clap, clap, clap! “Goodbye, teacher! Goodbye, friends!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "hello friend song for kids"

en.flash: Mới: yes, no | Ôn: hello, goodbye, teacher, friend, boy, girl
en.slide: 1) Nghe câu hỏi và chạm Yes (bạn gật đầu) hoặc No (bạn lắc đầu) (4 câu): Are you a boy? (tranh Leo) / Are you a girl? (tranh Leo) / Is it Leo? (tranh Bông) / Is it the teacher? (tranh cô giáo). 2) Nghe và nối tên với tranh (4 nhân vật): Bông – a girl / Leo – a boy / Anna – a girl / the teacher. 3) Đóng vai chào hỏi theo cặp: Hello, friend! – Hello! / Are you a girl? – Yes! / Goodbye, teacher! – Goodbye!
en.truyen: A new friend — Anna comes to class. She looks: a boy and a girl. “Hello!” Leo: “Hello! Are you a boy?” Anna: “No, no! I'm a girl. I'm Anna.” Leo: “I'm Leo. I'm a boy.” Bông: “Hello, Anna! Are you my friend?” Anna: “Yes!” Teacher: “Good job, friends!” Ding, dong! “Goodbye, teacher! Goodbye, Anna!”
en.baihat: Goodbye Song — giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb: Goodbye, teacher, yes, yes, yes, / yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, / Goodbye, teacher, goodbye, friends, / goodbye, bye-bye, bye! (Lời 2: Are you a boy? No, no, no, / no, no, no, no, no, no, / Are you a boy? No, no, no, / I'm a girl, bye-bye!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 5. Unit 2 · Name and age – Tên con là gì? Con mấy tuổi?

web.label: Ngày 9. Unit 2 · Tên con là gì?

en.tu: Mới: name, one, two | Ôn: hello, boy, girl, friend
en.cum: my name / your name / one, two
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: What's your name? – My name is…] What's your name? – My name is Leo. / My name is Bông. / One, two – clap, clap!
en.truyen: What's your name? — Leo: “Hello! What's your name?” Girl: “My name is Anna. What's your name?” Leo: “My name is Leo.” Anna and Leo: “One, two – clap, clap!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what's your name song for preschool"

web.label: Ngày 10. Unit 2 · Đếm 3, 4, 5 – Con mấy tuổi?

en.tu: Mới: three, four, five | Ôn: one, two, name
en.cum: one, two, three / four, five / I'm four / I'm five
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: How old are you? – I'm + số] How old are you? – I'm four. / How old are you? – I'm five. / One, two, three, four, five!
en.truyen: How old are you? — Teacher: “Bông, how old are you?” Bông: “I'm four.” Teacher: “Leo, how old are you?” Leo counts: “One, two, three, four, five. I'm five!” Teacher: “Good job!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how old are you song for kids count to five"

en.flash: Mới: name, one, two, three, four, five | Ôn: hello, friend, boy, girl, yes, no
en.slide: 1) Nghe số và chạm đúng số chấm (5 câu): one / two / three / four / five. 2) Nghe và chạm bạn đang nói (3 câu): My name is Leo. / My name is Bông. / My name is Anna. 3) Nghe tuổi và chạm bạn (3 câu): I'm four. (Bông) / I'm five. (Leo) / I'm three. (Nhan)
en.truyen: What's your name? — Teacher: “Hello, friends! What's your name?” “My name is Bông.” “My name is Leo.” “My name is Anna.” Teacher: “How old are you, Bông?” Bông: “I'm four.” Leo: “One, two, three, four, five – I'm five!” Anna: “I'm five, too!” Teacher: “Good job!”
en.baihat: One, Two, Three, Four, Five — giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star: One, two, three, four, five, / What's your name? My name is Leo! / One, two, three, four, five, / How old are you? I am five!

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 6. Unit 2 · Name and age – Sinh nhật vui vẻ

web.label: Ngày 11. Unit 2 · Sinh nhật và bánh

en.tu: Mới: birthday, cake | Ôn: three, four, five, name
en.cum: happy birthday / a birthday cake / my birthday
en.cau: Happy birthday, Leo! / It's my birthday. / Look! A birthday cake! / I'm five!
en.truyen: Leo's birthday — It's Leo's birthday. Look! A birthday cake! Bông and Anna: “Happy birthday, Leo! How old are you?” Leo: “I'm five! One, two, three, four, five!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "birthday cake song for kids preschool"

web.label: Ngày 12. Unit 2 · Ôn unit + truyện Sinh nhật Anna

en.tu: Ôn: name, one, two, three, four, five, birthday, cake, friend, teacher, yes, no
en.cum: my name / your name / happy birthday / a birthday cake / I'm five
en.cau: What's your name? – My name is Anna. / How old are you? – I'm five. / Is it your birthday? – Yes! / Look! A cake!
en.truyen: Anna's birthday — Leo: “Hello, Anna! Is it your birthday?” Anna: “Yes!” Bông: “How old are you?” Anna: “I'm five!” Look! A birthday cake. Friends count: “One, two, three, four, five!” “Happy birthday, Anna!” Leo: “Teacher, is it your birthday?” Teacher: “No, no!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "birthday party song for preschool counting candles"

en.flash: Mới: birthday, cake | Ôn: name, one, two, three, four, five, teacher, friend
en.slide: 1) Nghe tuổi và chạm chiếc bánh có đúng số nến (4 câu): I'm three. / I'm four. / I'm five. / I'm two. 2) Nghe và chạm tranh (4 câu): birthday / cake / name / friend. 3) Trò chơi Thổi nến: cô hỏi How old are you? – I'm five!, cả lớp đếm one, two, three, four, five rồi cùng thổi nến trên slide.
en.truyen: Anna's birthday — It's Anna's birthday. Leo: “Hello, Anna! Is it your birthday?” Anna: “Yes!” Bông: “How old are you?” Anna: “I'm five!” Look! A birthday cake. Friends count: “One, two, three, four, five!” “Happy birthday, Anna!” Leo: “Teacher, is it your birthday?” Teacher: “No, no! It's Anna's birthday.” Clap, clap, clap!
en.baihat: Look, a Cake! — giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb: It's my birthday, look, a cake! / Look, a cake! Look, a cake! / It's my birthday, look, a cake! / One, two, three, four, five! (Lời 2: Happy birthday, Anna, Anna… / How old are you? I'm five!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 7. Unit 3 · Family – Mẹ, bố, em bé và anh chị em

web.label: Ngày 13. Unit 3 · Mẹ, bố và em bé

en.tu: Mới: mommy, daddy, baby | Ôn: name, birthday, cake
en.cum: my mommy / my daddy / hello, baby
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: This is my + người thân] This is my mommy. / This is my daddy. / Hello, baby!
en.truyen: Bông's mommy — Bông: “Look! This is my mommy. This is my daddy.” Mommy: “And this is the baby.” Bông: “Hello, baby!” Baby: “Ba-ba!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "mommy daddy baby song for toddlers"

web.label: Ngày 14. Unit 3 · Anh trai, chị gái

en.tu: Mới: brother, sister | Ôn: mommy, daddy, baby, boy, girl
en.cum: my brother / my sister / a boy / a girl
en.cau: This is my brother. He's a boy. / This is my sister. She's a girl. / Is he your brother? – Yes!
en.truyen: My brother Nhan — Bông: “This is my brother. His name is Nhan. He's three.” Leo: “This is my sister. Her name is Xiaomei. She's five.” Nhan and Xiaomei: “Hello!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "brother and sister song for kids family"

en.flash: Mới: mommy, daddy, baby, brother, sister | Ôn: name, one, two, three, four, five, birthday
en.slide: 1) Nghe và chạm người thân trong tranh gia đình Bông (5 câu): mommy / daddy / baby / brother / sister. 2) Nghe câu và chọn tranh đúng (3 câu): This is my mommy. / This is my brother. / This is my sister. 3) Trò chơi Ngón tay gia đình: cô nói Hello, Daddy! con giơ ngón cái, Hello, Mommy! con giơ ngón trỏ, Hello, brother! con giơ ngón giữa, Hello, sister! con giơ ngón áp út, Hello, baby! con giơ ngón út.
en.truyen: Bông's family — Bông: “Hello! My name is Bông. Look! This is my mommy. This is my daddy.” Mommy: “And this is the baby.” Bông: “Hello, baby!” Bông: “This is my brother. His name is Nhan. He's three.” Leo: “This is my sister, Xiaomei. She's five.” Nhan and Xiaomei: “Hello, friends!”
en.baihat: Where Is Mommy? — giai điệu Frère Jacques: Where is Mommy? Where is Mommy? / Here I am! Here I am! / Hello, hello, Mommy! Hello, hello, Mommy! / I love you! I love you! (Lời 2: Where is Daddy? … / Lời 3: Where is brother? … / Lời 4: Where is sister? … / Lời 5: Where is baby? …)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 8. Unit 3 · Family – Ông bà và cả nhà

web.label: Ngày 15. Unit 3 · Ông bà và cả nhà

en.tu: Mới: grandma, grandpa, family | Ôn: brother, sister, mommy, daddy
en.cum: my grandma / my grandpa / my family
en.cau: This is my grandma. / This is my grandpa. / This is my family. / I love my family.
en.truyen: My family — Bông: “Look! This is my family. This is my grandpa and this is my grandma. This is my mommy and my daddy. This is my brother, Nhan, and the baby. I love my family!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "family song for preschool grandma grandpa"

web.label: Ngày 16. Unit 3 · Ôn unit + truyện Sinh nhật bà

en.tu: Ôn: mommy, daddy, brother, sister, grandma, grandpa, baby, family, one, two, three, four, five, birthday, cake
en.cum: my family / my grandma / happy birthday / a birthday cake
en.cau: This is my family. / Happy birthday, Grandma! / Look! A cake! / Mommy – one, Daddy – two, Nhan – three!
en.truyen: Grandma's birthday — It's Grandma's birthday. Mommy, Daddy, Nhan, Bông and the baby: “Happy birthday, Grandma!” Look! A birthday cake. Grandpa counts: “Mommy – one, Daddy – two, Nhan – three, Bông – four, the baby – five!” Grandma: “I love my family!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "happy birthday grandma song for kids"

en.flash: Mới: grandma, grandpa, family | Ôn: mommy, daddy, brother, sister, baby, birthday, cake
en.slide: 1) Nghe và chạm tranh (4 câu): grandma / grandpa / family / baby. 2) Nghe và xếp cả nhà vào khung ảnh theo lời cô (5 câu, con chỉ, cô kéo): This is my grandpa. / This is my grandma. / This is my mommy. / This is my daddy. / This is my family! 3) Nghe Yes/No theo tranh gia đình Bông (3 câu): Is this Grandma? / Is this Daddy? / Is this the baby?
en.truyen: Grandma's birthday — It's Grandma's birthday. Mommy, Daddy, Nhan, Bông and the baby come in: “Happy birthday, Grandma!” Look! A birthday cake. Grandma: “Hello, baby! Hello, Nhan! Hello, Bông!” Grandpa counts: “Mommy – one, Daddy – two, Nhan – three, Bông – four, the baby – five!” Bông: “And Grandpa!” Grandma smiles: “I love my family!” Clap, clap, clap!
en.baihat: This Is My Family — giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus: This is my grandma, grandma, grandma, / This is my grandpa, I love them so! / This is my mommy and my daddy, / This is my family, hello, hello! (Lời 2: This is my brother, brother, brother, / This is my sister and the baby, too…)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 9. Unit 4 · Body – Đầu, mắt, tai, mũi, miệng

web.label: Ngày 17. Unit 4 · Đầu, mắt và tai

en.tu: Mới: head, eyes, ears | Ôn: mommy, daddy, baby
en.cum: my head / two eyes / two ears
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: This is my… / These are my…] This is my head. / These are my eyes. / These are my ears. / One, two – two eyes!
en.truyen: Baby's eyes — Mommy: “Look, baby! This is my head. These are my eyes. One, two – two eyes!” Baby: “Ba-ba!” Mommy: “And these are my ears.”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "head eyes ears song for toddlers"

web.label: Ngày 18. Unit 4 · Mũi và miệng

en.tu: Mới: nose, mouth | Ôn: head, eyes, ears
en.cum: my nose / my mouth / one nose / one mouth
en.cau: This is my nose. / This is my mouth. / One nose, one mouth, two eyes!
en.truyen: Funny face — Leo: “Look, Bông! This is my nose. This is my mouth. Two eyes and two ears.” Bông: “Ha ha! Funny face!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "nose mouth eyes ears song preschool"

en.flash: Mới: head, eyes, ears, nose, mouth | Ôn: mommy, daddy, baby, grandma, grandpa
en.slide: 1) Nghe và chạm bộ phận trên khuôn mặt (5 câu): head / eyes / ears / nose / mouth. 2) Nghe câu và chọn tranh đúng (3 câu): This is my nose. / These are my eyes. / This is my mouth. 3) Trò chơi Mặt chú gấu: cô đọc từ, con chạm lên mặt mình rồi chạm slide để gắn bộ phận đó cho gấu (5 lượt): eyes / nose / mouth / ears / head.
en.truyen: Grandpa's funny face — Grandpa: “Look, Nhan! This is my head. These are my eyes. This is my nose.” Nhan: “And this is your mouth, Grandpa!” Grandpa: “Yes! And these are my ears.” Nhan: “One, two – two ears! Ha ha! Funny face!”
en.baihat: This Is My Head — giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush: This is my head, my head, my head, / This is my head, hello, hello! / These are my eyes, my eyes, my eyes, / These are my eyes, hello, hello! (Lời 3: These are my ears… / Lời 4: This is my nose… / Lời 5: This is my mouth…)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 10. Unit 4 · Body – Tay, chân và chạm

web.label: Ngày 19. Unit 4 · Tay, chân và chạm

en.tu: Mới: hands, feet, touch | Ôn: nose, mouth, head
en.cum: touch your head / touch your nose / clap your hands / my feet
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu mệnh lệnh Touch your… / Clap your…] Touch your head. / Touch your nose. / Clap your hands. / Look at my feet!
en.truyen: Touch your nose! — Teacher: “Touch your head!” Leo touches his head. “Touch your nose!” Bông touches her nose. “Clap your hands!” Clap, clap, clap! “Look at your feet!” Ha ha! “Good job!”
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "touch your head action song for kids"

web.label: Ngày 20. Unit 4 · Ôn unit + truyện Mũi của em bé

en.tu: Ôn: head, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, hands, feet, touch, mommy, baby, sister, family
en.cum: touch your nose / clap your hands / my eyes / my ears
en.cau: Touch your nose, baby! / No, baby! This is your nose. / Clap your hands! / Yes! Good job!
en.truyen: Baby's nose — Mommy: “Touch your nose, baby!” The baby touches her ears. Bông: “No, baby! These are your ears. This is your nose!” The baby touches her nose. “Yes! Good job!” Mommy and Bông clap their hands.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "head shoulders knees and toes kids song"

en.flash: Mới: hands, feet, touch | Ôn: head, eyes, ears, nose, mouth

Red, blue, yellow, green, pink, orange and white!” Nhan: “Where's my black ball?” Bông: “Is it on the bed?” “No!” “Is it on the sofa?” “No!” Woof! The dog has it! Ha ha! Nhan: “Eight balls!”
en.baihat: How Many Balls? — giai điệu This Old Man (dân gian): How many balls? Let's count them all! / One, two, three, four, five – a ball! / Six, seven, eight, nine, ten – / Count them all again! / How many balls? Ten balls, ten balls!
